full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media portrait places a seated man in a dark formal jacket and vivid red trousers before a dense patchwork of colored rectangles. The man is centered slightly left, shown from head to upper legs, with his hands loosely joined in his lap. His dark hair is neatly parted, and his face is rendered in muted gray with a composed expression directed a little to the left. The black high-collared jacket closes with a vertical row of round gold buttons. Several ribbon bars and circular medals shine across the upper chest, while narrow gold bands mark the cuffs. White shirt cuffs appear at the wrists, just above the pale hands. The red trousers make a broad warm shape across the lower portion, and the figure sits against a dark chair that is only partly visible. Behind him, rectangles of ochre, teal, cobalt blue, orange, crimson, cream, and charcoal cover the picture from edge to edge. Some are clean flat blocks; others contain faint floral designs, rubbed grain, or faded printed-like imagery. Their varied sizes create an irregular grid that runs behind the shoulders and into every corner. A bright blue square near the upper right and yellow blocks toward the left establish strong accents, but the near-black jacket remains the central visual anchor. The collage surface feels assembled from differently aged papers or painted fragments, with visible worn edges and texture. The face and hands are more softly modeled than the hard rectangular background, separating the seated figure from the mosaic. Light appears even and frontal, gently defining the facial planes and bringing a few metallic points on the jacket forward; the background contributes color rather than cast shadows. No readable words are visible. The overall composition mixes a formal, still pose with a lively arrangement of flat color and weathered surfaces, balancing personal presence against rhythmic abstraction.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形混合媒介肖像：一个穿深色正式外套和鲜红长裤的坐姿男子置于密集彩色矩形拼布前。他略偏左居中，从头画到大腿上部，双手松松合在膝上。深发整齐分开，面孔用低调灰色塑形，神情沉稳，视线略朝左。黑色高领外套由一列圆形金纽扣扣起。几条绶带和圆形勋章在胸上发亮，袖口有窄金边。浅色手腕上方露出白衬衫袖口。红色长裤在下方构成宽阔暖色形块，身下的深色椅子只部分可见。他身后，赭黄、青绿、钴蓝、橙色、深红、奶油色和炭色矩形从一边铺到另一边。有的色块干净平整，另一些含隐约花纹、磨擦颗粒或褪色的印刷状影像。不同尺寸形成不规则网格，从肩后一直延伸至每个角落。右上附近的亮蓝方块和左侧黄块建立鲜明强调，但近黑外套仍是中央视觉锚点。拼贴表面像由不同陈旧程度的纸片或绘画碎片组装，能看到磨旧边缘和肌理。面容与双手比硬矩形背景塑形更柔和，把坐姿人物从镶嵌色面中区分出来。光线看起来均匀而偏正面，轻柔界定面部平面，并让外套上少数金属亮点向前浮出；背景主要贡献色彩，而非投影。画中没有可读词语。整体构图把正式、静止的姿态与活跃的平面色彩及旧化表面结合，在个人存在感与节奏化抽象之间取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: Mixed-media image-making layers a softly modeled focal form over an irregular grid of flat rectangular fields. Bright cobalt, ochre, red, teal, cream, and charcoal are distributed in uneven blocks, some clean and others abraded or faintly patterned. Hard geometric seams create a lively backdrop, while smoother tonal transitions and a dark central mass establish a clear hierarchy. Small metallic-looking highlights add a secondary rhythm without competing with the broad color areas. Light is generally even; depth comes from overlapping surfaces, material wear, and the difference between soft modeling and flat collage. The overall effect combines formal stillness with playful chromatic fragmentation.
style_prompt_zh: 混合媒介图像把柔和塑形的焦点形体叠在不规则矩形色域网格前。亮钴蓝、赭黄、红、青绿、奶油色和炭色分布为不均一的色块，有的干净，有的磨蚀或带隐约纹样。坚硬几何接缝制造活跃背景，较平滑的明暗过渡和中央深色大块则建立清楚层级。小面积金属状亮点增添次级节奏，却不与宽阔色面竞争。照明总体均匀；纵深来自表面叠压、材质旧化，以及柔软塑形和平面拼贴之间的差异。整体效果把正式的静止感与俏皮的色彩碎片结合。
theme_en: A seated man in formal dress against a patchwork of colored squares
theme_zh: 身穿正式服饰的坐姿男子置于彩色方块拼布前
name: Peter Blake
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
